snippet.title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Sanctuary of Sarras - Expansion Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4132150/Tainted_Grail_The_Fall_of_Avalon__Sanctuary_of_Sarras_DLC/

Sanctuary of Sarras is the first full-fledged expansion for Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon! It launches December 15, 2025, at 1 PM EST / 7 PM CET on Steam and consoles!

Get ready for 10-15 hours of new adventures. Explore a completely new zone shaped by the deep sea. Meet intriguing characters and hear their stories. Clash with unique bosses and various other enemies. Venture into over 20 hand-crafted dungeons and interiors. Collect more than 100 new items, including weapons, armor, spells, relics, and more!

Dive in and unravel the secrets of Sarras!


#taintedgrail #expansion #sarras #rpg
